title: This app is so underrated!!!
body: The app is completely free, I can’t even find its premium version. Moreover, it seems like the number of your habits is unlimited (compared to other apps which only allow you create about 3 to 8 habits in free version). This app is simple yet effective and user-friendly, and its design based on scientific theory. Love it 💕
